name: Crescent Tower: Rising
storyline:
The Tower of the Arc Moon, an unconquered dungeon that appears just once every 50 years in the Imperial Capital Mayirdoam.

No one knows what lies at the top, yet rumors abound of a jewel that grants any wish the heart desires and of a potion of immortality.

The Logbook of Bravery, left behind by the man closest to achieving Tower Victory, now inspires others to begin a new adventure.
summary: Crescent Tower: Rising is an 8-bit-style RPG where players explore a tower that appears once every 50 years, aiming to reach its summit with a party of customizable heroes. The game features a five-chapter interwoven story, classic turn-based combat, and deep character customization, including 14 classes and a skill-block system. With a mapping system to uncover secrets and a playtime of 15-25 hours, it blends retro aesthetics with modern RPG mechanics.
